length.title: Measure the mat length
length.body: Measure the mat along the target line with a tape, twice. The two readings must agree within {tol}.
width.title: Measure the mat width
width.body: Measure the mat from your side to the phone side, also twice.
ball.title: Where the ball sits
ball.body: Measure from the ball spot to the long mat edge on the phone side.
ball.label: Ball to the phone-side edge
ball.hint: Most ranges are about {v} {unit}; leave it empty if unsure
bay.title: Bay depth (optional)
bay.body: Measure from the ball to the partition or wall in front of you. It tells how far and how high the face-on phone can go, and makes ball numbers more accurate.
bay.label: Ball to the partition in front
bay.hint: The tripod itself takes about 25 cm
bay.skip_hint: You can leave it empty: the standard distance is used.
finish.title: Last step
finish.body: Give it a name. Slope and tee are optional; they make ball numbers more accurate.
pair.need_second: Measure again and enter the second reading.
pair.bad: Readings differ by {d}, more than {tol}: measure again
reason.mismatch: The two readings differ too much
reason.range: That does not look like a mat size; check the unit
reason.edge: The ball must be on the mat
reason.bay: That distance is too short; check the unit
name.label: Venue name
slope.title: Mat slope (optional)
slope.hint: Lay the phone flat on the mat for 3 seconds to measure the slope.
slope.measuring: Measuring — do not touch the phone…
slope.unavailable: This device cannot measure the slope: enter it by hand
tee.title: Tee
tee.hint: A fixed rubber tee at the range lifts the ball.
flock.title: The lens is calibrated during the first setup
flock.body: The first time you set up here, after you tap the mat corners the app measures twice more and remembers the lens; you will not need to do it again.
save_no_repo: This browser cannot store data; the venue was not saved
list.title: Venues

list.delete_body.one: This venue and its {n} camera spot are deleted. Your shots are kept.
list.delete_body.other: This venue and its {n} camera spots are deleted. Your shots are kept.

list.empty_body: A measured mat makes the ball numbers more accurate.
